definitions.explanation: Used to refer to each thing or person in a group separately.

examples.english: Each person has their own room.
Each country has its own culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧それぞれ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: The students each have different opinions.

examples.japanese: ⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、それぞれ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Look at the menu and each of you please choose what you like.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧それぞれ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{合|あ}っている→取り合う：12000_toriau⟧。
examples.english: After graduation, the three went their separate ways, but they still keep in touch.

notes:
それぞれ means "each" or "respectively," referring to individual members of a group.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- それぞれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: each (noun)
- それぞれ + verb: each (does something)
- Can function as noun or adverb
- それぞれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧: each country
- それぞれ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: each different
- それぞれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧: each person's opinion
- それぞれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go one's separate ways

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧: each (more formal, used with counters)
- ⟦{個々|ここ}→個々：11619_koko⟧: individual, each one
- ⟦めいめい→銘々：03976_meimei⟧: each (older expression)
